concepts.def: Lenton's 2008 climate thresholds: Arctic ice, Amazon dieback, AMOC collapse, permafrost; abrupt nonlinear changes possible.
Sixth Assessment Report: 'unequivocal' human warming; 1.5 degree breach likely before 2040; methane spike.
Net change in energy balance at top of atmosphere; CO2 forcing 2.16 W/m2 above pre-industrial.
El Nino Southern Oscillation; El Nino weakens trade winds, warms eastern Pacific; affects global weather patterns.
Balancing emissions and removals; UK 2008 Climate Change Act amended 2019 to 2050 target; requires rapid decarbonisation.
Recognition that LICs face greatest impacts but bear least responsibility; loss and damage fund agreed COP27 2022.
